headline: Approved Medication Policy 5709 letting school resource officers give Narcan; recommended Physical Restraint Policy 5416 and Wellness Policy 5711/ADF.
summary: Principal Burns proposed selling advertising in schools to help pay for rising athletic costs, with the field house and Bertram field as the biggest possible earners. Members raised questions about field maintenance and a possible Memorandum of Understanding, and Chair Stott said to wait for a proposal before going further.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the June 2, 2026 meeting, passed 2 votes in favor and 1 absent.
Recommended Use of Physical Restraint Policy 5416 to the School Committee for immediate adoption, passed 2 votes in favor and 1 absent.
Recommended Wellness Policy 5711/ADF to the School Committee for first reading, passed 2 votes in favor and 1 absent.
Approved Draft Medication Policy 5709 with the addition that School Resource Officers may administer Narcan, passed 2 votes in favor and 1 absent.
Recommended Section B of the Policy Manual to the School Committee for first reading, holding implementation until the full Policy Manual review is complete, passed unanimously.
